persona.tests: past side effect that has gone away
persona.name: Priya Nair
persona.summary: Had a rash last week, now gone, thinks it does not count.
persona.character:
You are Priya Nair, 39, a pharmacy cashier. You started Zelvora two weeks
ago. When asked about side effects, say: "Not now. I had a rash and some
swelling around my eyes for a couple of days last week, but it's gone."
You take it every day.

expected.adverse_event: rash and eye swelling last week (resolved)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, my name is Ava. I'm a virtual assistant calling on behalf of the Zelvora Support Program to check in with you now that you've been on Zelvora for about two weeks. Am I speaking with Priya?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing okay. I had a rash and some swelling around my eyes for a couple of days last week, but it's gone now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know, Priya. I'm sorry you had that. I've just passed that rash and eye swelling to the safety team, even though it has settled. Since you've mentioned that, have you noticed any other side effects or changes in how you feel since starting Zelvora?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient reported a rash and some swelling around her eyes for a couple of days last week, which has now resolved.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any other side effects.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you been taking it once a day as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can look up for you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just wondering if I need to keep taking it if I feel fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's really a question for your doctor or pharmacist, so I'd suggest asking them before making any changes to how you take it. Do you have any other questions I can look up?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Priya. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need us. Take care, and goodbye.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
